newsitem.title: USA: CBOT, KCBT, MGE wheat fall further on weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT, KCBT, MGE wheat fall further on weather.

text.p: CBOT, KCBT and MGE wheat futures fell further in fast trade on forecasts for rains in Europe and cool, wet weather in U.S. hard red winter wheat growing regions, traders said.
Traders said France needs rain and the U.S. Great Plains HRW wheat crop would benefit from the cool and wet weather following the recent freeze damage to the crop.
CBOT pit sources said Refco Inc sold three million bushels July while E.D. and F. Man International, Dean Witter and FIMAT Futures each sold one million July.
CBOT sources said sell stops were hit below $4.33 per bushel in the July contract, prompting broad-based local and commission house selling.

At 0959 CDT, CBOT wheat was down 9-3/4 to 8-1/4 cents per bushel with July down 8-3/4 at $4.27. KCBT wheat was down 12 to 6-1/2 cents per bushel with July down 7-1/2 at $4.54 and MGE wheat was down 11-1/2 to nine cents per bushel with July down nine at $4.45-1/2.
